system.description:
As part of casting a Ninjutsu, or a Bukijutsu using a weapon from the Blade Group, you can spend 1 Viper Blood. If you do, on a failed save, in place of one condition the jutsu inflicts, you can inflict the Virulent condition following the jutsu’s normal rules. If the jutsu does not inflict a condition, then force one affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs jutsu’s save DC, becoming Virulent on a failure.

If you spend 3 Viper Blood as part of the aforementioned jutsu disciplines casting, then you can inflict both Virulent condition and the jutsu’s original condition. Also, if the jutsu does not inflict a condition, then you can force all affected creatures to make the Constitution saving throw, gaining the Virulent condition, on a failure.
